summary: As Florida State Representative, Nixon introduced HR 31C calling for an immediate cease-fire in Israel and occupied Palestine, the sole lawmaker to cite Palestinian deaths before the vote failed 104–2 and she was called anti-Semite. In 2026 she called Netanyahu 'a war criminal,' stated opposition to sending Israel any U.S. money or weapons, and pledged on her Senate platform to end U.S. support for West Bank settlements and uphold the Gaza ceasefire.
